question:
What is the missing number in the given diagram?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83f6fd574fb412f5b365e799988d5714799088878414f10bdf88e3a34af3a6a4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0932ac152fd67c84b49fceef834ba8cf2653dfbf7ff5e271d7814d46d0b2e53e.png] ⇒ 5 + 3 + 7 = 15

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4e556c9da8cb8cd54bf96085b3aad7687634109e688cb0b52efd21548fad63c.png] ⇒ 6 + 4 + 5 = 15

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38e4b93c7314aa53553edc9314b204f61500852ab6f6808250e7342ddc3fa67c.png] ⇒ ? + 8 + 3 = 15 

⇒ ? = 15 - 11

⇒ **? = 4**

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
